::: {layout-ncol="2"}
::: {.profile-copy}
I am an applied economist at the Tata-Cornell Institute for Agriculture and Nutrition (TCI), Cornell University, Ithaca, NY. My research lies broadly in the area of developmental impact evaluation with a focus on food security, nutrition, agriculture, social protection, and political economy.
:::

## Selected Publications

- [Reproducibility and robustness of economics and political science research](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10251-x) (with Brodeur et al.). *Nature*. 2026.
- [Status Inequality and Public Goods](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0305750X23003443?via%3Dihub) (with Bharathi, N, Malghan, D, & Mishra, S). *World Development*. 2024, 176, 106526.
- [Ethnic Diversity and Economic Development with Spatial Segregation](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0165176522004256) (with Bharathi, N & Malghan, D). *Economics Letters*. 2023, 222, 110951.
- [India’s Rural Transformation and Rising Obesity Burden](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0305750X20303855) (with Aiyar, A & Pingali, P). *World Development*. 2021, 138, 105258.
- [Fractal Urbanism: City Size and Residential Segregation in India](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0305750X21000097) (with Bharathi, N, Malghan, D, & Mishra, S). *World Development*. 2021, 141, 105397.
- [Universal food security program and nutritional intake: Evidence from the hunger-prone KBK districts in Odisha](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.foodpol.2016.07.003). *Food Policy*. 2016, 63, 73–86.
